_doc: AUTHORING SURFACE — hand-edit freely. The page reloads this every boot (no-cache).
One entry per unlock. Order does not matter; the page sorts by time.
t     absolute seconds into the song (song is 256.84s). Preferred — this is the timeline.
pct   fraction of duration 0..1 — use INSTEAD of t if you want it to float with length.
icon  any emoji or short string
Delete an entry to remove it, add one to create it. The ACHV rail spaces pips by COUNT,
not by time, so adding or removing entries is always safe.
NOTE: labels below say '62%', '80%' etc. If you move a time, edit the label text too —
If this file is missing or invalid, the page falls back to the 12 built into the HTML.
